sections.p: Your learning progress is stored only in your browser (localStorage). Masteva does not receive or send this data anywhere.

sections.h: When you sign in with Google
sections.p: Masteva receives your email address, display name, profile picture (URL) and user ID from Google to create your account. Your learning progress (checked items, topic statuses, starting levels and when you changed them) is saved to your account so you can use it on several devices. When you sign in, Supabase Auth also records your IP address and browser information for the sign-in session and its security log. It is not used for advertising and is never sold or shared with third parties.
Account data is stored on Supabase (servers in Singapore). Only you can read and change your own progress.

sections.h: How long data is kept and how to delete it
sections.p: Account and progress data are kept until you delete your account. Choose "Delete account" in the account menu to delete your account, your sessions and all progress saved to it; deletion takes effect immediately and cannot be undone. Supabase Auth's security log is kept by Supabase under its own policy.
Send any request about your personal data to {contact}.
